data.name: Fishing：Across china
data.detailed_description:
"Fishing Around China" is a hardcore fishing simulation game. Players can fish in major river basins across China, unlock rare fish catches, and enjoy a rich equipment DIY system. The game features realistic systems for bait, weather, water temperature, and more.

Various fishing gear, various lure boats, over 100 species of Chinese native fish

Cast your line and prepare for the ultimate relaxing yet thrilling experience with "Fishing：aroud china,"a game that masterfully blends serene simulation with the authentic excitement of the catch! This isn't just a game—it's your personal portal to the world's most beautiful and challenging fishing spots, all from the comfort of your screen .

The heart of "Fishing：Around China" lies in its realistic and engaging mechanics. You'll start by selecting your tackle, choosing from a variety of fishing rods, reels, lines, hooks, and bait

. The game features an intuitive casting system where you can aim and control the strength of your throw. Once your line is in the water, the real challenge begins. You must pay close attention to the bobber; when a fish bites, a quick and well-timed reaction is needed to set the hook

. The fight to reel in your catch is a dynamic mini-game where you must carefully manage line tension, balancing between applying pressure and letting the fish run to avoid breaking your line

. Different fish species have unique behaviors, requiring you to adapt your strategy for each encounter
